title: Octavia Court’s manager charged $9,892 in overhead without HUD approval

beats.text: Federal housing money supported fifteen homes at Octavia Court in San Francisco.

visual.sub: The project’s accounts included $9,892 of unapproved management overhead

beats.text: Auditors found $9,892 in property manager overhead charged without federal approval.
The manager believed the costs were allowable.

visual.kicker: The project’s accounts included $9,892 of unapproved management overhead

beats.text: A separate error started when the project signed a new management agreement.

visual.kicker: Accounting continued billing the old, higher fee

beats.text: Accounting kept billing at the old, higher rate.

visual.kicker: Accounting continued billing the old, higher fee

beats.text: The auditor put that overstatement at $639.

visual.kicker: Accounting continued billing the old, higher fee

beats.text: In the following year, the auditor found no similar overhead charges.

visual.kicker: A different fee calculation was $417 too high the following year

beats.text: But the calculation for commercial space overstated its management fee by $417.
The auditor recommended checking the amounts against the contract.

visual.kicker: A different fee calculation was $417 too high the following year

beats.text: The 2019 review found the management fee appeared correctly calculated.

visual.kicker: The following audit reported the management fee appeared correct

beats.text: The reports do not specify whether the earlier overstatements were repaid.
Every source is linked in the case file below.
